div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

text.tspan: • Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)

• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

div.div:
LOC_BROKEN — in dirty passageYou are in a dirty broken passage. To the east is a crawl. To the
west is a large passage. Above you is a hole to another passage.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. EAST, CRAWL → LOC_SMALLPITBRINK
2. UPWAR, HOLE → LOC_FLOORHOLE [Ch 03]
3. WEST → LOC_DUSTY
4. BEDQU → LOC_BEDQUILT [Ch 05]

div.div:
LOC_WINDOW1 — at window on pitYou're at a low window overlooking a huge pit, which extends up out of
sight. A floor is indistinctly visible over 50 feet below. Traces of
white mist cover the floor of the pit, becoming thicker to the right.
Marks in the dust around the window would seem to indicate that
someone has been here recently. Directly across the pit from you and
25 feet away there is a similar window looking into a lighted room. A
shadowy figure can be seen there peering back at you.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. EAST, Y2 → LOC_Y2
2. JUMP → LOC_NECKBROKE [Ch 11]

div.div:
LOC_Y2 — at "Y2"You are in a large room, with a passage to the south, a passage to the
west, and a wall of broken rock to the east. There is a large "Y2" on
a rock in the room's center.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. PLUGH → LOC_FOOF4 [Ch 01]
2. SOUTH → LOC_FLOORHOLE [Ch 03]
3. EAST, WALL, BROKE → LOC_JUMBLE
4. WEST → LOC_WINDOW1
5. PLOVE ⚡ special(2) [carry EMERALD]
6. PLOVE → LOC_FOOF5 [Ch 06]
